title: Economy
description: Money rules that are constants in golf.exe's code (one row, "game", so a mod may write just the field: "set": {"hole_upkeep": 2}). Money is in units of $100. Money that changes with the difficulty (start cash, wage period) is in the difficulty table.

sandbox_cash.description: Cash of a new Sandbox game, in $100.

hole_upkeep.description: Charged per open hole at every wage period, in $100 (Maint./Interest).

debt_interest_divisor.description: Once a month negative cash grows by cash / this (50 is 2 percent of the debt).

fire_fee.description: Paid when an employee is fired, in $100 (Salaries).
